name: School Management – Print Isolation & Manual Bulk Fields Fix
notes: Receipt/result printing now prints only the intended receipt or result, and Bulk Student Entry fields can be manually selected.
changes: Fee Receipt print now prints receipt only, not the Fee Collection form/screen
Bus Fee Receipt print now prints receipt only, not the Bus Fee form/screen
Student Result / Marksheet and Print All Results now print only result sheets, not the Result form/screen
Test Report print now prints only the selected report
Student Bulk Entry now has manual field selection and selected-column template generation
Bulk Entry selection is saved in Customize / Settings and controls Excel paste column order
Bulk Entry keeps 10-digit mobile and 18-digit CTS validation
Last saved fee/bus fee receipt is tracked so Print Receipt prints the intended entry
Removed stale Admission No. reference from Hall Ticket Receipt search
Preserved existing QR, sidebar scroll, admin login, student validation, schedule and principal signature features
